items.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of real_net_assets or total_backing_signed beyond the qualitative statement that backing is overstated by exactly the borrow amount; the exact relation total_backing_signed = real_net_assets + borrow_value is stated in prose but not as a numeric formula with operands.
Report does not give a numeric definition of real_surplus in terms of totalBackingSigned and borrow_value; only the qualitative claim that reported backing must not exceed real backing is stated.
